pow_gate_summary.rule: Every mandatory gate must pass independently. Preliminary screens and shared-runner measurements cannot pass a gate.

pow_gates.gap: One million matching vectors across two independent implementations and three CPU architectures are not complete.
The preserved screen used eight shared-runner seeds, not 1024 unbiased seeds per device.
The complete controlled matrix on three declared low-cost systems is absent.
No exact attacker has demonstrated total measured attack memory at or below half the declared scratch memory, and two independent models are absent.
Batches through 4096 were screened, but the advantage after ordinary hardware occupancy is not measured on controlled hardware.
Optimized implementations across three CPU classes and two GPU ecosystems are absent.
An independently reviewed FPGA implementation or estimate is absent.
Two independently reviewed ASIC cost models are absent.
Two independent reversible-circuit estimates and an approved economic first-mover model are absent.
The profile is specified but two interoperable mining implementations have not demonstrated it.

latest_evidence.conclusion: Informational only; exact output used external storage and unbounded OS caching, so the time-memory gate remains open.
Dependency and batch diagnostics found substantial reuse and setup amortization, but did not produce exact proofs after cache misses.
Exact no-spill outputs retained 0.06 percent of ordinary throughput but used 150 percent peak scratch allocation.
Metadata-aware caches leave material misses even for an unattainable oracle, but miss counts are not executable recomputation proofs.

next_milestone.stage_a: Exact versioned scratch graph and byte model implemented; no gate assessed.
next_milestone.stage_b_lower_bound: Optimistic offline cut-set replay floor implemented; no gate assessed.
next_milestone.required_outcome: Search graph-only pebbling schedules and report recomputed nodes, dependency depth, peak retained values, and encoded schedule bytes before attempting an online evaluator.
